Clear first-aid guides, ready without an AI download. Saved for offline use after your first visit finishes loading.

Minor cuts and grazes
Control bleeding, rinse a small wound, then protect it with a clean dressing.
Burns and scalds
Cool a heat burn promptly with cool running water for 20 minutes.
Adult choking
Act immediately when a choking adult cannot cough, speak or breathe effectively.
Severe bleeding
Call for emergency help and apply firm, continuous pressure to visible severe bleeding.
